- Translate countdown units in all five interface languages, with spaces between numbers and units.
- Keep Latin text and digits in the same font when switching languages. Use a fixed fallback order for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean characters.
- Localize calendar month and weekday names; use Windows regional settings for date formats and the first day of the week.
- Update to MyGo 0.5.1 and replace handwritten translation lookup with checked ICU catalogs.

Download the Windows x64 or ARM64 ZIP, extract it, and run `Countdowner.exe`. Keep the `licenses/` directory. Portable and unsigned.
